game.name: Sequential Hidden Choice
game.description: A private type acts first; the responder observes the action but not the type.

game.name: Public Signal Game
game.description: A noisy public signal is revealed between the private first decision and the response.

game.name: Coupled Decision Game
game.description: The first private decision changes both the public-signal distribution and the continuation beliefs.

limitations: Synthetic two-player zero-sum games only; no poker ranges or betting recommendations are produced.
Normal-form support enumeration is intentionally limited to small games.
Decomposition uses finite inner solves, so its operator includes finite-solve error.
Passing U gates does not change historical Gate D and does not promote any dataset to Verified.
